checks.text: The page displays the heading "Gradient Generator" and the text "No gradients saved" in the library panel.
Clicking the button "Add stop" once adds one list item "Stop 1" showing the text "#ff0000" and the text "0%".
After one stop exists, typing "50" in the "Position" field of Stop 1 and pressing Enter shows "50%" in the Stop 1 item and the CSS preview text becomes "linear-gradient(90deg, #ff0000 50%)".
Clicking "Add stop" twice yields "Stop 1" (#ff0000, 0%) and "Stop 2" showing "#0000ff" and "100%"; the CSS preview text is "linear-gradient(90deg, #ff0000 0%, #0000ff 100%)".

With two stops added, selecting "Radial" in the select labelled "Type" changes the CSS preview text to "radial-gradient(circle, #ff0000 0%, #0000ff 100%)" (it contained "linear-gradient" before the change).
With two stops added, clicking the button "Copy CSS" puts exactly the CSS preview text "linear-gradient(90deg, #ff0000 0%, #0000ff 100%)" on the clipboard and shows the toast "CSS copied".
With two stops added, typing "Sunset" in the field labelled "Name" and clicking the button "Save gradient" adds a library item containing "Sunset"; the text "No gradients saved" is gone.
After saving "Sunset", clicking the button "Delete Sunset" removes it and the text "No gradients saved" returns.

With two stops added, setting Stop 1's Position to "50" (Enter) and saving the gradient as "Sunset", reloading the page keeps the library item "Sunset" and the stop list still has "Stop 1" showing "50%".
